difficulty_reason: The new residual after giving the triangle-removal/diamond-free result is a two-stage construction. First the author chooses a dense reflection intersection A_z=A intersect(z-A), whose symmetry converts positive-corner-freeness into absence of either sign of nonzero corner while controlling density loss by averaging. Then the author encodes points as incidences between vertical, horizontal and slope-minus-one lines in a tripartite graph. Triangle geometry makes every graph edge belong to exactly one triangle precisely because nonzero corners are absent; edge count3|A_z| converts the diamond-free bound into |A|=o(N^2). The sign reduction is necessary for the encoding and is not an added hypothesis. This coordinated symmetrization and incidence design is non-routine and fully supplied by the author. The complete author triangle-removal and diamond-free proofs are retained as H1 support with0extra independent count; the older energy core953is not counted again.
